I've answered Hollis in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted it himself on 9 June in #central-team, a channel he's in. It's the ticket with the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. The import file labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow Agrisupply's booking sheet uses 01/02.

A ticket number counts as an operational fact, so it was fine to post in that channel. Everyone in it is on the Central team.
